name: Contract views preserve equality hashing and identity-less behavior

input.source_text: contract Named { fun name() -> Symbol } class Item { public fun name() -> Symbol { :item } } impl Item for Named {} let item = Item.new(); let left = item as Named; let right = item as Named; let identity = try { left same? right } catch error { error }; %[left == right, left.hash() == right.hash(), identity]

applicability.reason: Contract-view equality, hash, and identity failure are observable from source.
